annotations.title: Check: price, networks and fee wallets

description: The paid Check of any wallet: price { maximum (dollars, the most a Check costs, every network), perNetwork (one consultation), amount (= maximum, for older clients), currency }; tools: the base tools switched on now (Scorechain and Merkle Science; one Vurto switched off is not listed); the price of a Check is perNetwork times the networks chosen, never above maximum. checkNetworks [{ chainId, family }] (the seven to choose: 1, 10, 56, 137, 8453, 42161, solana-mainnet), networks [{ chainId, family, token (the USDC that pays), feeWallet }] (where it is paid: the nine EVM networks and solana-mainnet), creditLimit and chargeValidSeconds (1800). optionalTools [{ tool: "crystal", kycRequired: true, perNetwork, maximum }]: Crystal on top of Scorechain and Merkle Science, with the price per network and the maximum WITH it; empty when it is not sold or is switched off. check_charge leaves a tool that is switched off out of a new purchase, without charging it, and says so in skippedChecks; with no tool that gives a score left (Merkle Science or Crystal), check_unavailable (503). Public, no proof needed.
name: check_info
